methodology_notes.k_source_collection: Scanned main.tex + all body_vN.tex + reproducibility_audit/*.md for each paper to maximize K-reference coverage. Latest body_v3 used as canonical but all versions checked to capture historical K references.
methodology_notes.kb_search_method: grep for both 'K123' and 'k123' (case-insensitive) experiment_id in knowledge.json — file is ~2MB so grep is safe and avoids full-file read
methodology_notes.experiment_dir_matching: Fuzzy match: exact lowercase match OR prefix match (e.g., k799_ variants). Covers k824v2, k783b etc.
methodology_notes.gap_definition: Documentation gap = experiment directory exists in experiments/ AND no knowledge.json entry with matching experiment_id. This is distinct from 'no-source' in prior reports (which means no matching experiment exists at all).
methodology_notes.truly_missing_definition: K referenced in paper tex but no experiments/ dir AND no KB entry. K54/55/76/77 are very low-numbered — pre-K-numbering era, likely predating the K-ID experiment system.
methodology_notes.known_limitation: K1181 appears in both Paper2 and Paper3 — counted once in gap list but in both papers' reference sets. K1045 (shared methodology experiment) is documented in KB but referenced by all 4 papers.
